goal: Provide structured log entries to kernel library consumers instead of pre-formatted strings
Free kernel callers from brittle string parsing to inspect timestamps, levels, and categories
Remove node-specific logging complexity and dependencies from the kernel build
agreement: Concept approval for rationalizing the kernel logging API with minimal disruption (ryanofsky)
Approval after memory leak and allocation deadlock issues were resolved (w0xlt)
Unaddressed objection: singleton logger introduces viral coupling across kernel components (purpleKarrot)
Addressed concerns regarding initialization order and side effects in log arguments (ajtowns)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it decouples the kernel from node logging internals and eliminates node build dependencies
Unblocks downstream kernel decoupling work in #30342 and #33847
